title: Customizable, no-code voice agent automation with GPT-4o
summary: Retell AI is transforming the call center with AI voice automation powered by GPT-4o and GPT-4.1. Its no-code platform enables businesses to launch natural, real-time voice agents that cut call costs, boost CSAT, and automate customer conversations—without scripts or hold times.
body: Retell AI is transforming the call center with AI voice automation powered by GPT-4o and GPT-4.1. Its no-code platform enables businesses to launch natural, real-time voice agents that cut call costs, boost CSAT, and automate customer conversations—without scripts or hold times.
summaryZh: Retell AI利用OpenAI的GPT-4o和GPT-4.1模型，构建了一个无代码语音代理自动化平台。该平台旨在重塑呼叫中心业务，通过实时、自然的语音交互替代传统脚本，帮助企业在无需复杂开发的情况下，实现客户服务自动化，从而有效降低运营成本并提升客户满意度（CSAT）。
